items.name: Silver Tankard
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 2 cp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionWhether it is a simple pottery cup or an elaborate drinking stein with a handle and decorative lid that flips up, this cup may be used to hold any sort of beverage. Tankards are commonly made out of clay or tin.

items.name: Outfit, Courtier's
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 89, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 159
Price  30 gp; Weight  6 lbs.
Category Clothing
DescriptionThis outfit includes tailored clothes in whatever fashion happens to be current in noble courts of that region. Anyone trying to influence nobles or courtiers while wearing street dress will have a hard time of it (-2 penalty on Charisma-based skill checks to influence such individuals). items.name: Silver Locket
items.description: A silver locket depicting a beautiful, buxom young blonde woman.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Leather armor is made up of multiple overlapping pieces of leather, boiled to increase their natural toughness and then deliberately stitched together. Although not as sturdy as metal armor, the flexibility it allows wearers makes it among the most widely used types of armor.

items.name: Ring Of Swimming
items.description:
Description
This silver ring usually has fishlike designs and motifs etched into the band. It continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.
Base Item: 
RequirementsForge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in Swim
Source: Ultimate Equipment
